Source: @vahidkarimipour

When a single film takes the place of thousands of articles and speeches. The cinematic, documentary-style film "The Voice of Hind Rajab," which has shone at numerous international festivals and drawn widespread attention to the killing of the people of Gaza by the Israeli army, tells the story of a girl who seeks help from the Red Cross to save herself. The film captures the tireless, anxiety-ridden efforts of those striving to show the world that in this corner of the earth, the life of a small child is as precious as anywhere else in the world. Their lives can neither be destroyed with cannons and tanks, nor can they be put at risk in the fight against occupation. https://www.aparat.com/v/fgv2442
